members.name: PawSharp.Core.Builders.EmbedBuilder
members.summary: Fluent builder for constructing  objects.
members.example:
var embed = new EmbedBuilder()
                .WithTitle("Hello World")
                .WithDescription("This is an embed built with PawSharp.")
                .WithColor(0x5865F2)
                .WithAuthor("My Bot", iconUrl: "https://example.com/icon.png")
                .AddField("Field 1", "Value 1", inline: true)
                .AddField("Field 2", "Value 2", inline: true)
                .WithFooter("PawSharp v0.5.0")
                .WithTimestamp()
                .Build();

members.name: PawSharp.Core.Entities.AllowedMentions
members.summary:
Controls which mentions (users, roles, @everyone) Discord will actually notify
             when a message is sent.  Passing an  object in
             CreateMessageRequest.AllowedMentions overrides Discord's default "ping everything"
             behaviour so bots can quote/forward messages safely.

members.name: PawSharp.Core.Entities.AllowedMentions.Parse
members.summary:
An array of allowed mention types.  May contain "roles", "users",
            and/or "everyone".  When null Discord falls back to its default behaviour.
            Mutually exclusive with  /  — if you specify
            individual IDs, do NOT list the corresponding type here.

members.name: PawSharp.Core.Entities.AllowedMentions.Users
members.summary:
Up to 100 user IDs to mention.  May only be used when  does NOT
            contain "users".

members.name: PawSharp.Core.Entities.AllowedMentions.Roles
members.summary:
Up to 100 role IDs to mention.  May only be used when  does NOT
            contain "roles".

members.name: PawSharp.Core.Entities.AllowedMentions.RepliedUser
members.summary:
When true, pings the author of the message being replied to.
            Ignored on non-reply messages.

members.summary: Suppresses all mentions — nothing in the message will ping anyone.

members.name: PawSharp.Core.Entities.AllowedMentions.All
members.summary: Allows all mention types (Discord's default).

members.name: PawSharp.Core.Entities.AllowedMentions.PingRepliedUser
members.summary:
Pings only the author of a replied-to message; suppresses all other pings.
            Equivalent to new AllowedMentions { Parse = [], RepliedUser = true }.

members.name: PawSharp.Core.Events.EventInterestAttribute
members.summary:
Declares which gateway events a handler is interested in, enabling intent validation
            and automatic filtering of irrelevant events.
members.remarks:
This attribute enables the event dispatcher to:
            1. Validate that required intents are enabled at connection time
            2. Warn developers when a handler expects an event but the required intent is missing
            3. (Future) Filter events at the dispatcher level for performance
            
            Example:
            
            [EventInterest(GatewayEvents.MessageCreate, GatewayEvents.MessageDelete)]
            public async Task OnMessage(MessageCreateEvent evt) { ... }

members.name: PawSharp.Core.Events.EventInterestAttribute.#ctor(System.String[])
members.summary: Creates an event interest declaration from event type names.
members.remarks:
The provided event types are validated against the known gateway events.
            If an unknown event is specified, it will be included but not warn on intent mismatch.

params.name: eventTypes
params.description: Gateway event type names (e.g., "MESSAGE_CREATE", "READY")

members.name: PawSharp.Core.Events.EventInterestAttribute.CalculateRequiredIntents(System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable{System.String})
members.summary: Maps gateway event types to the required intents.
members.remarks:
This mapping is based on Discord's official documentation of which intents
            are required for each event type. Unknown events return (GatewayIntents)0.
